Saudi Arabia Launches Direct Flights from Hyderabad to Riyadh

Saudi Arabia's flyadeal airline has launched direct daily flights from Hyderabad to Riyadh, marking a significant expansion of air services between the two countries. The new flights are expected to enhance connectivity and economic ties between India and Saudi Arabia. The move is seen as a positive development for the Indian aviation sector, which has been seeking to increase its presence in the Middle East market.
